notes.title: Fantasy Network Demo LIVE SHOWCASE
notes.content: Fantasy Network is an upcoming action-adventure game set in a modern era where citizens are connected by social networking and there are several talents shows to win besides the classical jump and fight genre schema. Paolo Cattaneo, the game's author, plays the game live explaining how he came up with his idea and what were the most difficulties hit while developing.
